source_snapshot.procedure_direct_xlsx: 【Before Test】 1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition. 2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.). 【During Test】 Hardware required: RDIMM with ECC / HDT Software tool: AMD RAS Error Injection Tool 1. BIOS settings: a. CPU Common Options → Platform First Error Handling: Enabled b. CPU Common Options → MCA error thresh enable: TRUE c. CPU Common Options → MCA error thresh count: FFE (Deviate from default setting FF5) d. UMC Common Options → DDR RAS → RCD Parity: Enabled e. UMC Common Options → DDR RAS → Disable Memory Error Injection: False f. FCH Common Options → FCH RAS Options → Reset After Sync-Flood: Enabled 2. Unlock CPU via HDT. 3. Boot into Ubuntu 20.04/RHEL 9.0 / Windows 2022. 4. Download the AMD RAS Error Injection Tool, then install and open the software. 5. Enter the following commands: sudo ./cmdline_amdraserrorinjectiontest –-listvalidumc 6. Uncorrectable Error Injection, enter the following commands: sudo ./cmdline_amdraserrorinjectiontest --dramothererrors --errortype 0 --socketdieumc 0:0:3 --enablemcapolling 0 --errormode 0 6.1. The system will reset immediately. 6.2. When system boot into operating system again, check dmesg log, a message should be issued from BERT. 【After Test】 1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders. 2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria_direct_xlsx: 1. For correctable errors, the tool provides a PASS status. 2. For uncorrectable errors, verify that the errors are logged correctly in BERT dmesg after the warm reset is triggered. 3. If the OS reports the error within a timeout period, the test passed. 4. If the OS does not report the error within a timeout period, the test failed.
source_snapshot.deepseek_direct_xlsx: PARTIAL | -- Memory slot 1~N: inject the DRAM parity uncorrectable error on Memory slot 1~N via the AMD RAS Error Injection Tool (after HDT/unlock + the BIOS RAS knobs from the procedure, e.g. Platform First Error Handling=Enabled + per-unit MCA/UMC settings). Agent stages/verifies with sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "dmesg -T 2>&1 | tail -160 | grep -iE 'corrected|uncorrected|mce|EDAC|umc|address.error|parity'; echo __DRAM_parity_uncorrectable_error_on_Memory_slot_1~N; ipmitool sel elist 2>&1 | tail -40 2>&1" but the tool injection step itself is interactive/HW-level and needs the user to drive the exact inject command.

required_package: Vendor-correct listvalidumc syntax and tool/spec version/hash/license

Slot/RCD to socket/die/UMC/channel/rank map and approved replacement/meaning of 0:0:3
Exact BERT CPER source/severity/location/syndrome oracle and log persistence path
Maximum dispatch-to-reset, boot and OS-ready deadlines plus permitted recovery
RCD Parity/MCA/Reset After Sync-Flood before/target/after values, abort and restoration
test_case.test_command: Obtain vendor mapping for dramothererrors errortype/errormode; correct the list syntax; map RCD/DIMM slots to socket/die/UMC/channel/rank; capture durable pre-state and OOB console; inject one approved UCE target; timestamp tool dispatch to reset, firmware/boot and BERT record; verify BERT source/severity/location matches the target and no boot loop or persistent parity state remains; restore RCD/MCA/injection/HDT state before separately approving another target.
